states.name: resting

states.name: standing

objects.label: mortar (usu)
objects.material: wood (carved wooden bowl, inner radius 0.125-0.15 m, 0.13 m deep, outer radius 0.205 m)
objects.notes: Child of MochiStation. Starts on the stump with its base at (0, 0.80, 0); UsuTablePlacer may move the station once at startup onto the player's real table. Every strike happens here: the dough sits in the bowl. Unity GameObject: Usu (bound with SatieCore.Bind).

objects.label: mochi dough
objects.material: soft, elastic, sticky pounded glutinous rice (about 2.2 kg)
objects.notes: Child of MochiStation at the usu floor; its rendered surface is the child MochiSurface. Dents under the kine, stretches into a tent when the kine lifts, then lets go and slumps back into a mound. Pushed and slapped by bare tracked hands. Unity GameObject: MochiSolver (bound with SatieCore.Bind).

objects.label: mallet (kine)
objects.material: wood (cylindrical head 12 cm across and 20 cm long on a long handle)
objects.notes: Stands on its face on the stump beside the usu until picked up (pinch or closed-hand grab on its handle). Swung by the player at up to about 4-8 m/s; in rhythm mode the partner swings it on the beat while nobody holds it. Its strikes sound at the usu (pound, rim_knock). Unity GameObject: Kine (bound with SatieCore.Bind).

objects.label: you
objects.notes: The headset (OVRCameraRig/TrackingSpace/CenterEyeAnchor). Room-scale VR with no locomotion: the player stands at the usu. Unity GameObject: CenterEyeAnchor (bound with SatieCore.Bind).

environment.setting: The Moon of the moon-rabbit legend: a small moonlit clearing ringed by bamboo, a golden cassia tree beside a wooden mochi mortar (usu) on a tree stump, two glowing stone lanterns; the Moon and Earth in the sky ahead (+Z)
environment.weather: Still and misty (ink-wash fog). No wind is animated anywhere in the world.
environment.ground: Soft packed earth in the clearing; forest earth and leaf litter under the bamboo; a few flat stepping stones leading out through the gap
environment.enclosure: Open air inside a ring of about 300 bamboo stalks 5.5-9.5 m tall, from 4.8 m to 15 m out from the mortar, open over 55 degrees toward +Z
environment.notes: Unity 6, Meta Quest 3 standalone, left-handed coordinates in metres, +Y up, the player faces +Z. Mixed reality: the player stands about 1 m south of the usu (camera rig at (0, 0.30, -1.0), floor tracking) and swings a virtual kine (mallet) held with tracked hands; a second person can knead the dough with bare hands between strikes. The usu stands on the stump at the origin (its base at y = 0.80 m), or, when the headset's room scan has a table within 3 m, the whole station moves once at startup onto the real table and the table shows through passthrough. The dough is a real-time particle simulation: it dents under a strike, sticks to the lifting kine and stretches up into a tent, lets go about 0.15 s into the lift and falls back into a mound. Nothing else in the world moves. The game has no sound at all yet.

events.name: pound
events.description: The kine's flat face meets the dough in the usu moving downward (faster than 0.8 m/s): a heavy wooden mallet into soft, elastic, sticky mochi in a wooden mortar. Louder and heavier with strike_speed (published just before the event). Swung by the player, or in rhythm mode by the on-beat partner when nobody holds the kine. From about one strike every 1-2 s to one per beat of a song.

events.name: rim_knock
events.description: A missed strike: the kine head hits the usu's wooden rim or wall instead of the dough. Wood on wood.

events.name: tent_release
events.description: As the kine lifts, the dough stuck to its face stretches up into a tent, then lets go of the kine about 0.15 s into the lift (all at once) and falls back into the mound: a sticky peel and soft flop.

events.name: dough_slap
events.description: A bare hand slaps or presses quickly into the dough (the kneader between strikes): a wet soft slap of palm on warm mochi.

states.name: free_play
states.description: No song: the player pounds and kneads freely in the quiet clearing.

states.name: rhythm
states.description: Rhythm mode: one of the player's own songs plays (Unity AudioSource, not Satie) and notes approach the rim; judgements are shown visually only. The ambience should sit under the music.

signals.name: strike_speed
signals.description: Downward speed of the kine face at the moment it reaches the dough or the rim. Published right before pound or rim_knock.

signals.name: kine_speed
signals.description: Speed of the kine head whenever it moves: held and swung, auto-pound, or the rhythm partner's swing (0 while it rests). For the swing.

signals.name: knead_speed
signals.description: Speed of the fastest bare hand that is touching the dough (0 when no hand touches it).
